title: Product Color Variation Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every color you sell with product photos. Upload your shade images, place each one in the same scene, and make a matching set for listings and ads.
lead: Create product color variations for the shades you sell without shooting a new scene for every color. Upload your shade photos and make a consistent still set for your store or ads.

steps.d: Upload a clear photo of each color you sell so every image starts with the right product and shade.
Choose one scene and describe the surface, light, and crop you want across the color set.
Download the matching still images for your product gallery, marketplace listing, or ad. Each image costs 24 credits.

faq.q: Who can use a product color template?
faq.a: Sellers with products in several colors can use these templates. Matching scenes make it easier for buyers to compare shades.

faq.q: Can I use my own product and shade photos?
faq.a: Yes. Use photos of the shades you actually sell. Check each generated color against the real product before posting.

faq.q: What are product color variation templates?
faq.a: They help you make matching photos for each color you sell. Shoppers can compare shades in the same setting without another photoshoot.

faq.q: Do I need photo editing experience?
faq.a: No. Upload your product photos and choose a setting. You can make matching color images without editing experience.

faq.q: How much does a color variation image cost?
faq.a: Each color image uses 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I show every color without another photoshoot?
faq.a: Yes. Make a matching image for every shade from the photos you already have. You can refresh your store gallery without another shoot.

faq.q: How do I make matching images for each shade?
faq.a: Upload photos of your real product shades and choose one shared setting. Download a matching image for each color in minutes.

faq.q: Where can I use these color variation images?
faq.a: Use the images on product pages, marketplaces, social posts, or paid ads. The matching setting helps shoppers compare your colors.

faq.q: Which products work well for color variations?
faq.a: Clothing, shoes, home goods, cases, and other products sold in distinct colors. Compare the generated shade with the product you ship.

faq.q: Can I use the images in paid ads or client work?
faq.a: Yes. Your watermark-free color images can run in paid ads or client work. Check that each shade matches the item being sold.

faq.q: What stays consistent across the color set?
faq.a: Keep the surface, crop, lighting, and product scale alike. Check each shade against the real item before you publish.
